name: Yuina Itomaki
source:
Yuina Itomaki is a citizen of Konohagakure Yuina is a quiet and shy girl. She's also very polite, always addressing people with proper honourifics. While not very out-spoken, she is firm in her decision of wanting to become a shinobi. In the presence of more out-spoken peers, she will follow them if they take an initiative, even when Yuina herself disagrees with their methods and viewpoints. Yuina has indigo hair with short bangs in the front and long and curled bangs dangling freely on Her hair is tied in round ponytails on each side and she has royal blue eyes.
